title: Press play. The archive has a podcast.
summary: Two voices, a new journey each month, and a free RSS feed. Explore history, ideas, and mythology from the Kyle Pounds archive.
announcement: New: the Kyle Pounds Archive podcast is live. Listen and subscribe free.
body: There is another way into this sprawling archive: through your headphones. Kyle Pounds Archive is a two-host podcast that takes the website’s history, ideas, and origin stories as a starting point for a journey you can listen to.

Some episodes pull back to connect a whole era. Others follow one person, one decision, or one difficult stretch of road. The aim is to help you picture the places and understand the choices people faced, with a fresh subject or angle each month.

The conversations are AI generated and this is an unofficial archive project. Ancient authors have their own perspectives; myths remain myths. The show aims to make those differences clear, and links back to the material behind each episode.

Try our newest journey, “The Long Road Home — Xenophon and the Ten Thousand,” following a Greek mercenary army’s struggle to get home from Persia. Or start with “Leaving Ithaca — Telemachus Begins the Odyssey,” a journey into the opening of Homer’s story. The earlier episodes are still available too. Listen here or on our free Spreaker page, or paste the RSS feed into your preferred podcast app.
A new episode is planned each month. This news page will carry new releases and other archive updates, so the announcement bar can point to what is current instead of keeping old notices around.
